news.title: Who do Americans think is going to win the World Cup?
news.summary_en: Most Americans say they are unlikely to follow the 2026 World Cup, though immigrants are far more likely than U.S.-born adults to tune in.

news.title: Federal agency X accounts are getting far more engagement in the second Trump term than under Biden
news.summary_en: Federal agencies are getting far more audience engagement on X in the second Trump administration than they did during the final year of the Biden administration.
